name: Movie Magic
tagline: Film picks, a running watchlist, and a weekly box-office roundup.
description: Ask for something to watch and it suggests films that fit, then keeps a watchlist you can come back to instead of losing titles up the scroll. Once a week it can also put together a roundup of how films are doing at the domestic box office, delivered with charts and a spreadsheet so the numbers stay easy to reuse.
author: king_rob_lo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
